Tone 1 + tone 1: high and level, twice.
Tone 1 + tone 2: stay high, then rise from the middle.
Tone 1 + tone 3: high, then one step down to the middle.
Tone 1 + tone 6: high, then low and clipped. jat6 ends in t.
Tone 2 + tone 1: rise from the middle, then high and level.
Tone 3 + tone 2: middle and level, then rise from the middle.
Tone 5 + tone 3: rise from low, then middle and level.
Tone 4 + tone 4: low and falling, twice.
Tone 4 + tone 6: fall low, then low and clipped. Compare 今日, today.
Tone 1 + tone 4: high, then all the way down.
Tone 5 + tone 6: rise from low, then low and level.
Tone 6 + tone 5: low and level, then rise from low.
Tone 6 + tone 6: low and level, twice. hok6 is clipped.
Tone 6 + tone 3: low, then middle and clipped. tit3 ends in t.
Two clipped syllables: low (6), then high (1).
Tone 2 + tone 6: rise from the middle, then low and level.
